Container.Name: NoorTasks
Container.Overview: NoorTasks is a self-hosted, local-first personal task manager, calendar, habit tracker, and focus timer backed by SQLite and an offline-capable PWA. Stores tasks, checklists, attachments, habits, Pomodoro sessions, and calendar integrations in /data with no external database container required.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the NoorTasks web UI and API

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, uploaded attachments, and config files

Config.Name: Initial Passphrase
Config.Description: Initial sign-in passphrase (minimum 8 characters). Hashed to /data/config.json on first boot; can be cleared afterward.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to true when serving NoorTasks exclusively over HTTPS via a reverse proxy

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to true behind a reverse proxy so sign-in rate limiting reads X-Forwarded-For

Config.Name: Auto-generate VAPID Keys
Config.Description: Set to true alongside NOORTASKS_VAPID_FILE=/data/vapid.json to auto-generate Web Push keys on first start

Config.Name: VAPID Key File
Config.Description: Optional path inside /data for Web Push VAPID keys (for example /data/vapid.json)

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (IANA name, for example Europe/Amsterdam)
